custom_statements.name: audit_events_chain_function
custom_statements.up:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ash_enterprise_audit_chain() RETURNS trigger AS $fn$
DECLARE
  prev text;
BEGIN
  -- The partition is taken from the event's metadata rather than from the caller,
  -- so the column and the metadata cannot disagree.
  NEW.organization_id := NULLIF(NEW.metadata->>'organization_id', '')::uuid;

  -- The tail of the row's chain, read backwards off the chain index. The two
  -- cases are written apart because `IS NOT DISTINCT FROM` cannot use the index,
  -- and the index's own order lets the planner see that an `IS NULL` match is
  -- already ordered by sequence.
  IF NEW.organization_id IS NULL THEN
    SELECT hash INTO prev
    FROM audit_events
    WHERE organization_id IS NULL
    ORDER BY organization_id DESC, sequence DESC
    LIMIT 1;
  ELSE
    SELECT hash INTO prev
    FROM audit_events
    WHERE organization_id = NEW.organization_id
    ORDER BY organization_id DESC, sequence DESC
    LIMIT 1;
  END IF;

  NEW.previous_hash := prev;
  NEW.hash := encode(sha256(convert_to(concat_ws('|',
      coalesce(prev, ''),
      NEW.sequence::text,
      NEW.id::text,
      NEW.record_id::text,
      NEW.version::text,
      NEW.occurred_at::text,
      NEW.resource::text,
      NEW.action::text,
      NEW.action_type::text,
      coalesce(NEW.user_id::text, ''),
      coalesce(NEW.organization_id::text, ''),
      NEW.data::text,
      NEW.changed_attributes::text,
      NEW.metadata::text,
      NEW.as_of::text,
      NEW.as_of_range::text), 'UTF8')), 'hex');

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$fn$ LANGUAGE plpgsql
SET TimeZone TO 'UTC'
SET DateStyle TO 'ISO, MDY'
SET IntervalStyle TO 'postgres'
SET extra_float_digits TO '1';

custom_statements.down: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS audit_events_chain ON audit_events;
custom_statements.name: audit_events_chain_trigger
custom_statements.up:
-- ash_enterprise_audit_chain: f331cccd712c4d79
CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER audit_events_chain
  BEFORE INSERT ON audit_events
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION ash_enterprise_audit_chain();
